schema:
bill(bill_no INT PK, outlet_no INT -> outlet.outlet_no, staff_no INT -> staff.staff_no, bill_date DATE, pay_mode VARCHAR(15) ['Cash', 'Card', 'Bkash'], tip INT)
bill_item(bill_no INT PK -> bill.bill_no, dish_code VARCHAR(5) PK -> dish.dish_code, qty INT)
dish(dish_code VARCHAR(5) PK, dish_name VARCHAR(40) ['Kacchi', ...], course VARCHAR(20) ['Main', 'Drink', 'Dessert', 'Starter'], price INT, calories INT)
outlet(outlet_no INT PK, title VARCHAR(40) ['Lakeside', 'Old Town', 'Skyline', 'Garden'], area VARCHAR(30) ['Gulshan', 'Wari', 'Banani', 'Uttara'], opened DATE, monthly_rent INT)
staff(staff_no INT PK, full_name VARCHAR(40) ['Rafi', ...], duty VARCHAR(20) ['Manager', 'Waiter', 'Chef', 'Cleaner'], pay INT, joined DATE, outlet_no INT -> outlet.outlet_no, reports_to INT -> staff.staff_no)

answers.question: Show the dish name and price of every dish in the Main course, most expensive first.
answers.sql:
SELECT dish_name, price
FROM dish
WHERE course = 'Main'
ORDER BY price DESC;

answers.question: How many bills were paid with each payment mode? Show pay_mode and the number as Bill_Count.
Show the title of outlets that have never issued a bill.
answers.sql:
SELECT T1.title
FROM outlet AS T1
LEFT JOIN bill AS T2 ON T1.outlet_no = T2.outlet_no
WHERE T2.outlet_no IS NULL;

answers.question: Find the total money earned from each dish (price times quantity). Show dish_name and the amount as Revenue, highest first.
answers.sql:
SELECT dish_name, SUM(price * qty) AS Revenue
FROM bill_item
JOIN dish ON bill_item.dish_code = dish.dish_code
GROUP BY dish_name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

answers.question: Show the dishes that were never ordered. Display dish_name.
answers.sql: SELECT dish_name FROM dish WHERE dish_code NOT IN (SELECT dish_code FROM bill_item);

answers.question: List bill_no and bill_date for bills in 2024 on which no tip was recorded.
answers.sql:
SELECT bill_no, bill_date
FROM bill
WHERE YEAR(bill_date) = 2024
  AND tip IS NULL;

answers.question: Show the total amount of each bill as Bill_Total with its bill_no, only for bills whose total exceeds 700.
answers.sql:
SELECT bill_no, SUM(price) AS Bill_Total
FROM bill
GROUP BY bill_no
HAVING SUM(price) > 700;

answers.question: Find the full names of chefs who are paid more than the average pay of all staff.
answers.sql:
SELECT T2.full_name
FROM staff AS T1
JOIN staff AS T2 ON T1.staff_no = T2.reports_to
WHERE T1.duty = 'Chef'
GROUP BY T2.staff_no
HAVING AVG(T1.pay) < AVG(T2.pay);

answers.question: Show the title of the outlet with the highest monthly rent.
answers.sql:
SELECT T1.title
FROM outlet AS T1
JOIN (SELECT outlet_no, MAX(monthly_rent) AS max_rent
      FROM outlet
      GROUP BY outlet_no) AS T2
ON T1.outlet_no = T2.outlet_no AND T1.monthly_rent = T2.max_rent;

answers.question: Show the full_name of waiters who served Kacchi on at least one bill.
answers.sql:
SELECT w.full_name
FROM staff w
JOIN bill b ON w.staff_no = b.staff_no
JOIN bill_item bi ON b.bill_no = bi.bill_no
JOIN dish d ON bi.dish_code = d.dish_code
WHERE d.dish_name = 'Kacchi'
GROUP BY w.staff_no
HAVING COUNT(b.bill_no) >= 1;

answers.question: Show the average pay per duty as Avg_Pay for duties having at least 2 people.
answers.sql:
SELECT duty, AVG(pay) AS Avg_Pay
FROM staff
GROUP BY duty
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

answers.question: Cut the price of drinks by 10 taka.
answers.sql:
SELECT 
    dish_code, 
    dish_name, 
    course, 
    price * 0.90 AS discounted_price, 
    calories
FROM 
    dish
WHERE 
    course = 'Drink';
notes:
two drafts gave different results; the other draft was:
SELECT 
    d.dish_code,
    d.dish_name,
    d.course,
    d.price * 0.90 AS discounted_price,
    d.calories
FROM 
    dish d
JOIN 
    bill_item bi ON d.dish_code = bi.dish_code
JOIN 
    bill b ON bi.bill_no = b.bill_no
WHERE 
    b.pay_mode = 'Card'
GROUP BY 
    d.dish_code, d.dish_name, d.course, d.price, d.calories;

answers.question: Create a view named Outlet_Income showing each outlet's title and its total income from dishes sold (price times quantity) as Income.
answers.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW Outlet_Income AS
SELECT o.title, SUM(d.price * bi.qty) AS Income
FROM outlet o
JOIN bill b ON o.outlet_no = b.outlet_no
JOIN bill_item bi ON b.bill_no = bi.bill_no
JOIN dish d ON bi.dish_code = d.dish_code
GROUP BY o.title;
